# EmendaKit AS

EmendaKit is a Norwegian medical device company that designs and builds anaphylaxis kits ("anafylaksiskrin") for healthcare professionals. Founded by a midwife with extensive experience in clinical practice and medical simulation. Designed and built in Norway by healthcare professionals. Tagline: "Innovasjon gjennom kunnskap og erfaring" (Innovation through knowledge and experience).

## Products

EmendaKit Anaphylaxis Healthcare (formerly EmendaKit Hospital): Anaphylaxis kit for healthcare services. Used in GP offices, health centres, hospitals, emergency departments, ambulances, helicopter air ambulances, maternity wards, vaccination stations, and private clinics. Waterproof, dustproof and shock-resistant transparent polymer case (IP67, withstands submersion in 1 metre of water for up to 30 minutes) with a smooth, easy-to-clean surface. A fitted insert gives each component its own marked compartment, with a light-protective cover over the adrenaline ampoules. The kit is delivered without medications; adrenaline (1 mg/ml), antihistamine and corticosteroid are ordered through the hospital or clinic pharmacy. Includes the printed Norwegian national anaphylaxis flowchart on the lid, a QR code linking to two training videos, a "Ny kontroll" (next check) date field on the front, and a wall holder. External dimensions 251 × 142 × 67 mm (internal 209 × 108 × 57 mm), weight 1.4 kg ready to use. Lifetime warranty under normal use. Price on request. Delivery time approximately 2 to 3 weeks. URL: https://www.emendakit.com/produkt/emendakit-hospital

EmendaKit Anaphylaxis Dental (formerly EmendaKit Dentist): Anaphylaxis kit for dental clinics, including oral surgery and orthodontics. The same kit and framework as EmendaKit Anaphylaxis Healthcare (251 × 142 × 67 mm external, 1.4 kg), with a flowchart adapted to dental services, where reactions to local anesthetics and latex are the most common triggers. Delivered without medications; a wall holder is included. Price on request. Delivery time approximately 2 to 3 weeks. URL: https://www.emendakit.com/produkt/emendakit-dentist

Custom kits ("behovstilpassede medisinske skrin"): Co-design service for healthcare departments with specific needs (maternity wards, vaccination programs, ambulance services, units with special requirements). Process: design conversation, packing proposal, pilot units, adjustment, delivery. Free initial design conversation by emailing kjersti@emendakit.com. URL: https://www.emendakit.com/tjenester/behovstilpasset

## Founder

Kjersti Grinde: founder, midwife with broad experience from emergency medicine, professional development and medical simulation. Initiated and developed EmendaKit from clinical practice.

## Clinical foundation

All products follow the Norwegian national anaphylaxis treatment protocol (revision 2024). The flowchart is printed on the back of every kit's lid: if staff do not remember how to manage anaphylaxis, the flowchart guides correct treatment. A QR code on the kit's side opens two short training videos. Training videos: https://www.emendakit.com/opplaering

## Contact

All inquiries: kjersti@emendakit.com
Quote requests: kjersti@emendakit.com (subject "Inquiry - EmendaKit Anafylaksi Helse" or "Inquiry - EmendaKit Anafylaksi Tannklinikk")

## Partners

Ann Jeanett Mølster, dentist and clinical adviser: contributed clinical insight to the dental version of EmendaKit Anaphylaxis. Erik Uthus and Fosen Tools (fosen-tools.no): Norwegian industrial development and manufacturing partner; the kits are designed and developed in Norway and produced by Fosen Tools. Vilje Helseklynge (viljehelseklynge.no): EmendaKit AS is a partner in this Norwegian health innovation cluster. URL: https://www.emendakit.com/samarbeidspartnere

## Adoption and media coverage

Helse Førde (Norwegian regional health trust) replaced all its older anaphylaxis kits with the standardised kit developed in the project "Nye anafylaksiskrin til Helse Førde"; 120 kits were procured in 2023 for the hospitals in Førde, Nordfjordeid and Lærdal. Coverage: Helse Førde news (September 2023), Firda (24 September 2023), Aksello incubator (5 September 2023), and Drivkraft / SpareBank 1 Sogn og Fjordane, which awarded Kjersti Grinde the Drivkraft grant (August 2026). Written feedback from Helse Førde (2026): Chief Executive Arve Varden states the kit is clearly organised, that staff find emergency medicines easily accessible, and that patients express it is a reassurance for them too. Monika Staberg Sunde, section manager of the oncology outpatient clinic, reports a kit in every treatment room, identical contents across the trust enabling one shared anaphylaxis procedure, and use of the kit in teaching nurses and doctors. Pål A. Hegland, coordinator for simulation and skills training, reports good feedback on functionality and an increased focus on anaphylaxis in simulation work. Experience from practice: https://www.emendakit.com/erfaringer · Media coverage: https://www.emendakit.com/omtale

EmendaKit AS, Norway. © 2026.

# EmendaKit AS (English summary)

EmendaKit is a Norwegian medical device company that designs and builds anaphylaxis emergency kits for healthcare professionals. Designed and built in Norway by healthcare professionals. Founded by a midwife with broad experience from emergency medicine. The company's philosophy: an emergency kit is not a product, it is part of the procedure, and must be treated accordingly.

Two standard products: EmendaKit Anaphylaxis Healthcare (for GP offices, health centres, hospitals, ambulances, maternity wards, vaccination stations and private clinics; formerly EmendaKit Hospital) and EmendaKit Anaphylaxis Dental (for dental clinics, oral surgery and orthodontics; the same kit with a dental-specific flowchart; formerly EmendaKit Dentist). Plus a custom-kit service co-developed with healthcare departments and other settings, including fitness centres, kindergartens, aviation and maritime, in public and private sectors.

All kits are waterproof, dustproof, shock-resistant and IP-67-rated, with a fitted insert, a printed national-protocol flowchart on the lid, a QR code linking to two short training films, and a wall holder. Kits are delivered without medications; the drugs are ordered through the hospital or clinic pharmacy. Pricing on request. Lead time approximately 2 to 3 weeks. Direct contact: kjersti@emendakit.com.
